plugins.name: sparki-video-editor
plugins.description: AI video editor for creators. Transform raw footage into polished vlogs, talking-head videos, or social content (TikTok/Shorts/Reels) via natural-language prompts, style presets, or reference-style cloning. Cloud-rendered via the Sparki API — no ffmpeg, no local rendering.
